modfile.changelog:
Hotfix 7.4.1 / The Last Pass — June 13

GENERAL CHANGES
A new ULTRA mini-boss now answers the call: a loud, fast brawler who cracks skulls with a club he swears is a silver sword and grows deadlier the longer you let him keep swinging. Shkath zai!
Eclipse no longer pierces immunities, only resistances
Eclipse now leaves the boss immune to force, fire and cold damage
Eclipse's tooltip was split into cleaner paragraphs (all supported languages)
Eclipse now also cleanses more negative effects that weren't accounted for before
Acid slimes no longer spawn outside of combat and properly dissolve when the fight ends (thanks @Bish)
Acid slimes no longer hold a grudge against their owner
Eclipse's stunning flash is a bit tighter now and slightly harder to shrug off
Dousing the Pyre with acid or radiant now knocks it down more reliably every round, but each splash counts for less
With Avarice active, felling the Adamantine Golem now also slips an epic-grade reward cube into the host's pack (thanks @gabsch)
Auto-selling certain odd pickups like a milk bottle or a barrel should no longer crash the game (thanks @vidarwolf)
Interplanar chests now spawn a touch higher, so they stop sinking into the floor (this won't work for every spawn point)
The Glass shard now actually stuns its wearer when they take damage, as the name rather strongly implied. Its spell crits also went from guaranteed to merely very likely
The Phlegethos shard's fire burst was dialed down, so loading a fistful of them onto one ring no longer snowballs into a bonfire
The Warlock shard's tooltip stops printing a broken value and finally admits its cantrip bonus equals your Strength modifier
The unarmed Armour Class shard actually grants its bonus now
The same unarmed damage shard can no longer be stacked onto one ring repeatedly
The critical strikes shard's tooltip now shows the true doubled dice
The Primordial Chaos shard now respects the stack limit instead of quietly sailing past it
The Improvisation shard turned a deep Bardic Inspiration pool into a cantrip machine gun, one cast per die. Its discount now fires once per turn
Probably fixed an issue where ULTRA mini-bosses wouldn't spawn on Myrkul
Your summoned creatures no longer pad out how many ULTRA mini-bosses show up
A mirroring ULTRA mini-boss only ever copies a real party member now, never a summoned pet
ULTRA mini-bosses that outlive the boss they came to aid now hunt the party down without mercy
ULTRA mini-bosses no longer scatter their own supplies when they fall
One ULTRA mini-boss's twin blades now bite with a chance to root whoever they cut
The cantrip reroll shard now trades away weapon accuracy in exchange
The guaranteed spell crit shard climbed to the rarest tier where it belongs (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
The Reclamation shard no longer multiplies returned shards after save reloads (thanks @Bish)

ITEM CHANGES
Primordial Chaos charges now respect their cap
The Potent Magic ring generates its charges again and honors the cap (thanks @ayrandros)
The Blade Ward armour's protection bonuses should now apply reliably (thanks @GGTsune)
Several pieces of gear that key off Mage Armor now read it on the wearer instead of the wrong target
A couple of items were loitering in the wrong rarity reward pool. They now drop from the planar coin that actually matches their rarity
The acid ring raises its decomposition aura right at the start of combat (thanks @77099)
The Whispering Vein's Carnage's Gift now stops stacking at its cap
The Miraculous Magic ring now reacts to harmful effects only, with a far better chance of soothing the wearer
The psychic knuckles' throw rider now states how far the target is flung
Three Paths of Shou Lung's wind stance no longer blinds on the lower tiers, but no longer grants the extra bonus action either
The knuckles now explain their special base strike, and the higher tiers make your fists count as magical
Adamantine forge gear now salvages at a humbler tier (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
Legendary unarmed damage shards now escalate their side effects properly (thanks @wh1te_ghost)
The Master's Cloak of Sacrifice no longer comforts your enemies (thanks @shyhvfgb)
The hydra cloak's recoil now bites its own wearer for the right amount (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
The Sovereign Tails' Leaden Limbs curse now shows an icon that actually exists (thanks @Vludber)
The Spellweaver greaves now honor the Potent Magic and Chaos stack cap their own tooltip kept promising
The Potent Magic tooltip now explains that its bonus scales with the effect's remaining duration (all supported languages)
The Jolly Lads disguise's Dex cap is now gone
The Uncommon perfection ring quietly shipped with the rarer tiers' warding interrupt. It does not anymore
The venomfang shortsword stops ignoring poison resistance at Rare, and shrugging off poison immunity is now a Legendary-only privilege rather than a Very Rare freebie
The soul cloak now props up Charisma saving throws from its very first tier instead of leaving them empty until Legendary
The vine longsword's Very Rare tier handed out a free entangling strike and razor gale every single turn. Both are now once per fight, like a normal weapon

VISUALS
The Crown of the Vengeful Spirits' visuals were fully reworked so repeated triggers no longer flood the screen

LOCALIZATION
German localization brought up to date with 7.4 (thanks @Zoey)

modfile.changelog:
Update 1.14.3

A batch of reworked artifacts and the usual round of community fixes.

GENERAL CHANGES

- The Runic Shard of Finisher now actually deals the extra critical damage its tooltip promises (thanks @bodoongo)
- The Runic Shard of Recurrence now carries its kept blessing into Act 3 (thanks @Uturn)
- The Runic Shard of Delirium should now drive a creature mad when it fails the mental saving throw (thanks @Uturn)
- The Runic Shard of Caldera now only creates its lava from fire damage dealt to enemies (thanks @rolandodata [OWLC])
- Weave Surge now applies its attack penalty to off-hand attacks as well (thanks @MRNameless0)
- Interplanar Chests now correctly spawn their loot when destroyed

DIFFICULTY

- A new ULTRA reinforcement setting has been added: limit how many reinforcement waves can be active in the same fight at once, from 1 to 5 or Unlimited. It is the last question in the reinforcement settings (thanks @rolandodata [OWLC])
- Myrkul has been further strengthened in ULTRA
- The Pyre now grants enemies less movement speed at every tier
- The Eclipse affix no longer triggers on a charmed or maddened companion (Minthara and others) who turns hostile for a moment (thanks @_jonf)

LOOT

- The Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength have been added to the rare glove pool (thanks @rolandodata [OWLC])
- The autoloot no longer keeps working in some cases after it has been turned off (thanks @elvira.from.hell)
- The Loot Manager no longer empties, sorts or throws away the Tutorial Chest and other chests summoned with the Training Ring (thanks @wh1te_ghost)
- The Lolth Cultist's Ring is now part of the swamp pool (thanks @wh1te_ghost)
- The Vest of Soul Rejuvenation is now part of the psionic pool (thanks @wh1te_ghost)

ITEM CHANGES

- The Psionic Helm has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Master's Cloak of Celestial Intuition has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Diadem of Arcane Synergy has been reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Jorgoral's Greatsword has been reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Foebreaker has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- The Scorching Whirlwind has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Spiderstep Staff has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Infernal Ring has been fully reworked (redesigned by @wh1te_ghost)
- Halo of Hope no longer damages allied undead. Its overall power is significantly lower at the lower rarities. Fixed several other bugs with it (thanks @Roue)
- Viper's Fang (Very Rare) now ignores resistance and immunity to poison, as the Legendary version does (per @RusMage Request)
- The Core of the Watcher should no longer register you as a Steel Watcher, so its dialogue lines stop appearing over your head (thanks @Scarcro, @heatray)
- Prisoner's Paradox should no longer trigger on damage you deal to yourself, so falling damage stops paralysing the party. Its explosion now rolls the save its description promised (thanks @MRNameless0)
- Chauntean Boots of Jubilation no longer heal the whole party without limit outside combat (thanks @eli)
- Orb of the First Soul no longer turns Invoke Duplicity into a crowd of illusions (thanks @Roue)
- The crossbow class action can be used again (thanks @CoriSlayer)
- Fixed the blinding passive on Justiciar's Scimitar. Shadowsoaked Blow now deals Psychic damage (thanks @wh1te_ghost)
- Fixed issues related to the recent Mutacid rework (thanks @ilarios, @kovi257)
- Mystra's Footsteps from Hatul Expansion now correctly show their bonuses, not just Arcana +20 (thanks @KnockNoble)
- The Cormyrean Elite tooltip now states that shots beyond your weapon's normal range are made with Disadvantage

LOCALIZATION

- Corrected and completed item and effect descriptions across all supported languages, restoring missing damage and saving throw values (thanks @rolandodata [OWLC])
